payload.prompt: Führen Sie die Gehaltsabrechnung für Marie Becker (marie.becker@example.org) für diesen Monat durch. Das Grundgehalt beträgt 44150 NOK. Fügen Sie einen einmaligen Bonus von 16200 NOK zum Grundgehalt hinzu.

payload.goal: Run payroll for Marie Becker for the current month with a base salary of 44150 NOK and a one-time bonus of 16200 NOK (total 60350 NOK).
success_checks: Employee Marie Becker exists in the system with email marie.becker@example.org
Payroll run created for current month
Base salary line of 44150 NOK registered
One-time bonus line of 16200 NOK registered

risk_notes: Employee Marie Becker may not exist in the sandbox — must be created first
Salary type for 'one-time bonus' must exist or be created in the system
Tax table / skattekort for Marie Becker is not specified — tax deduction may fail or default
Bank account for salary disbursement not provided
Payroll period (current month) must be open and not already closed
No employee ID or organization number provided — lookup/creation relies solely on name and email
VAT is not applicable to salary vouchers
payload.suggested_first_action: Look up or create employee Marie Becker via POST /employee with email marie.becker@example.org, then configure salary type lines before creating the payroll run.
ordered_steps: 2. If not found, POST /employee with name='Marie Becker', email='marie.becker@example.org'
3. GET /salary/type — verify salary types for base salary and one-time bonus exist
4. If bonus salary type missing, POST /salary/type to create one-time bonus type
5. POST /salary/payrun — create payroll run for current month
6. POST /salary/transaction — add base salary line: 44150 NOK for Marie Becker
7. POST /salary/transaction — add one-time bonus line: 16200 NOK for Marie Becker
8. PUT /salary/payrun/{id}/:complete — finalize and post the payroll run
9. GET /salary/payslip?employeeId={id} — verify payslip generated with total 60350 NOK
10. Confirm voucher posted in ledger via GET /ledger/voucher

rules: Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'NO_ACCESS' (safest default — avoids 422 errors). Only use 'STANDARD' if email login is explicitly needed.
startDate is a TOP-LEVEL field on the employee object. Do NOT put it inside an employments array.
dateOfBirth is a TOP-LEVEL field. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.

payload.text:
Let me analyze this task carefully:

1. The task is to run payroll for Marie Becker (marie.becker@example.org) for the current month
2. Base salary: 44150 NOK
3. One-time bonus: 16200 NOK
4. Total: 60350 NOK

From the sandbox_discovery, Marie Becker already exists with id 18616770.

The task type is "create_voucher" - so I need to create a payroll voucher in the ledger.

For a payroll/salary voucher, I need:
- Account for salary expenses (typically 5000 - Lønn/Salary)


- Account for salary payable or bank (typically 2910 for accrued salary or 1920 for bank)
- Employee reference on the postings

Since the employee already exists, I'll need to resolve the correct account numbers and create a voucher with a debit to the salary expense account (5000) for the full 60350 NOK and a credit to either the payable or bank account.

Most of the dedicated salary endpoints aren't available in the spec, so I'll work with the voucher creation approach instead—debiting 5000 (Lønn) and crediting either 2910 (Skyldig lønn) or 1920 (Bank) depending on what makes sense for the payroll flow. Looking at the account structure, I need to set up the payroll voucher with salary expense (5000) and salary payable (2910 or 1920) accounts, making sure to attach the employee reference to each posting and apply the exempt VAT type since payroll isn't subject to VAT.

Looking at this task, I need to:
1. Employee Marie Becker already exists (id: 18616770) per sandbox_discovery
2. Resolve salary expense account (5000) and bank account (1920)
3. Create a payroll voucher with two debit postings (base salary + bonus) and one credit posting

Let me start by resolving the account numbers:

I have:
- Account 5000 (Lønn til ansatte / Salary): id = 376613142
- Account 1920 (Bankinnskudd / Bank): id = 376612956
- Employee Marie Becker: id = 18616770

Now I'll create the payroll voucher. For salary vouchers, I need:
- Debit posting on account 5000 for base salary (44150 NOK) with employee reference
- Debit posting on account 5000 for bonus (16200 NOK) with employee reference
- Credit posting on account 1920 for total (-60350 NOK)

All with vatType 0 (no VAT on salaries).

payload.headline: All 4 payroll checks failed; used voucher approach instead of salary/payrun endpoints
what_went_wrong: Agent used POST /ledger/voucher instead of the salary/payrun or salary/transaction endpoints required by the scoring checks for payroll tasks.
The planner identified task_type=create_voucher but payroll tasks likely require dedicated salary endpoints (e.g., POST /salary/payrun, POST /salary/transaction) to pass scoring checks.
No salary type lookup was performed; the agent skipped steps 3-7 of its own plan and jumped directly to voucher creation.
Zero checks passed (0/8 points), indicating the scoring system expects a completely different API flow than what was executed.
what_worked: Employee lookup was skipped correctly using sandbox_discovery data (Marie Becker id=18616770).
No 4xx errors were produced; all API calls returned successfully.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /salary/payrun to create a payroll run for the current month, then POST /salary/transaction to add base salary (44150) and bonus (16200) lines linked to employee 18616770.
Check GET /salary/type first to find valid salary type IDs for base salary and one-time bonus before creating transactions.
Avoid the ledger/voucher approach for payroll tasks; the scoring system verifies salary-specific entities, not general ledger entries.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account (first call) — not needed if using salary endpoints instead of voucher
GET /ledger/account (second call) — redundant duplicate account lookup
POST /ledger/voucher — wrong endpoint for payroll; should use salary/payrun + salary/transaction
